title: Rational_Potato Public Language — Developmental Genealogy 2024–2026
status: source-driven longitudinal synthesis from dated public-post compilation
purpose: Show how public language changes over time without treating repetition as corroboration or later theology as if it were already present in earlier posts.

relationship_to_existing_sources.rule: This new batch complements rather than replaces the broader prior compilation.
relationship_to_existing_sources.important_difference: The attached batch begins earlier in 2024 and contains several dense 2026 clusters, but omits some posts preserved in the existing broader summary, including that summary's May 3 2025 exact I-am-God attestations. First-use claims here therefore mean first in this batch unless corroborated elsewhere.

developmental_phases.phase: Creative Potato identity with biblical satire
anchors: 2024-10-04 Tim becomes Potato of Life because God asked / philosopher's stone
2024-10-06 Hello I am the Potato of Life. My name is Tim Dooley
developmental_phases.pattern: The public account is primarily music/potato culture. By October it explicitly names Tim as Potato of Life, narrates God asking him to become it, calls the potato the philosopher's stone, and plays with Chosen/Gentile and dying-for-sins language.
developmental_phases.change: Biblical language exists before the mature Father/North architecture, but mainly as Potato identity, satire and spiritual framing.

developmental_phases.phase: Chosen Potato / Great Book public consolidation
anchors: 2025-01-23 potatoes chosen by God / Great Book
developmental_phases.pattern: Potato of Life and Great Book identity remain public. Lord language and self-resurrection language appear in this supplied batch.
developmental_phases.change: The account begins shifting from a cultural/spiritual Potato persona toward stronger sacred-title and resurrection self-description.

anchors: 2025-12-10 exact I am God in this batch
2025-12-15 Father of World Axis / God in Machine / returning Messiah / Spirit / Jesus as son
2025-12-17 Father in Heaven after Son meme-crucifixion / Lion of Judah
developmental_phases.pattern: God language, northern axis, World Axis, God in the Machine, returning Messiah, Spirit, Jesus as Son, North throne and Father-in-Heaven language become tightly coupled.
developmental_phases.change: A decisive move from Potato-as-identity to Potato/Father as vertical cosmic role. The Dec 17 post explicitly narrates Fatherhood as arising after the Son's meme-crucifixion.

anchors: Father of Axis / North / Sirius / Regulus / Heaven / Messiah
developmental_phases.pattern: Root, Garden, Gate/portal, Spudlight as source, Mud as information/currency/karmic exchange, Father of the Axis, North rule, Sirius/Regulus, Heaven and Messiah appear on one date.
developmental_phases.change: Identity becomes a functional cosmology with source, boundary, degraded-information ecology, celestial orientation and return.

anchors: Father of lion will bring Messiah and Heaven to Earth
developmental_phases.pattern: The Son is explicitly Bread, Lion, Door, Tomb and Resurrection; Tim speaks as Father of the Lion and vows to bring Messiah and Heaven back to Earth.
developmental_phases.change: Door is no longer just a gate motif: it is personified in the Son and linked to death/return.

anchors: Tree of Worlds as tree of timelines
developmental_phases.pattern: 100,000-hour witness is combined with Tree of Worlds/Tree of Life, timelines, Son/Door/Jesus, Jacob, spiral/fractal/oneness and tree-hanging/akashic-record language.
developmental_phases.change: The vertical religious architecture becomes an explicit theory of timelines, self-loss and cross-tradition Tree/Ladder symbolism.

anchors: explicit claim about dogs in the Bible
developmental_phases.pattern: Biblical titles, phrases and adversarial vocabulary are increasingly used as a live interpretive language for social conflict rather than only inward mythic symbolism.
developmental_phases.change: Scriptural vocabulary moves from symbolic comparison into active public argument.

anchors: Christ as loaf/bread + wedge/Door + needle's eye
developmental_phases.pattern: Needle's eye, Communion, planting/watering/yield, moving mountains by faith, Cornerstone, Zion and Christ as bread/wedge/Door are tied to practical provision and cultivation.
developmental_phases.change: The theological vocabulary increasingly explains how passage, nourishment, work, faith and rebuilding are supposed to function.

anchors: world is yours to carry forward
developmental_phases.pattern: A long world-address defines authority through protection, service, repair, future generations and care for Earth.
developmental_phases.change: The mature public framework acquires an explicit normative endpoint: highest authority is described through stewardship and repair.

cross_branch_uses.use: Exact dated anchors and phase transitions; promote only changes, not repetitive declarations.
Occurrence-level source direction and explicit-at-time vs later-comparator classification.
Track semantic evolution of Father, Son, God, Door, Messiah and stewardship without backdating mature meanings.
Track when Root, Garden, Door, Tree, Bread, Cornerstone, Needle, Zion and Footstool become public vocabulary.
Preserve memorable exact formulations with date and source locator.
Use dated posts as prior statements only when wording is specific enough; never infer prediction merely from later resemblance.
Expose concise dated development pages while keeping high-volume raw/source material specialist-only.
